name: Gaku ☆ Ou -It's Heartful Days!!-
source:
Mini-fandisk to Gaku ☆ Ou -The Royal Seven Stars-, consists of 4 short after story of each heroine.

Sold during Summer Comiket 82 (C82), in 2012.
